steps.expression: import { list } from '@openfn/language-sftp'; list('/', (state) => { console.log('✅ SFTP Connection successful!'); console.log(`Found ${state.data.length} items`); state.data.forEach(item => console.log(`- ${item.type}: ${item.name}`)); return { ...state, testResult: 'success', itemCount: state.data.length }; });
